title: Polkaswap Agent Trading API Schema
description: Request and response schemas for the same-page Polkaswap browser agent API.

planSwap.description: Waits for node readiness, then returns account-independent SDK-call planning metadata. quoteTimeoutMs bounds readiness and quoting separately. Not an executable intent, signing authorization, or SCALE transaction.

executeSwap.description: Generic execution rejects finalized-xyk-native-fee-v1 prepared intents with INTENT_MISMATCH. They await guarded bot execution and do not activate trading.

swapRequest.description: Omit execution for the legacy flow. Finalized execution requires the explicit selectors and resolves only KUSD/XOR in either direction.

swapAssessmentRequest.description: Omit execution for the legacy flow. Finalized execution requires the explicit selectors and resolves only KUSD/XOR in either direction.

preview.description: SDK invocation metadata only; no signer, authorization, or SCALE-encoded transaction.

goalFeeEnvelope.description: Fee estimation only: exact SCALE call and bounded envelope with a placeholder signature, never an authorizable transaction.

goalExecutionEvidence.description: Full detached immutable estimate is included in quoteDigest and prepared envelope. Canonical finality is RPC-attested; copied evidence grants no ownership, signature or trading authority.
